## Content: About (English)

18-year-old self-directed software developer and multiplayer game server engineer based in Ponorogo, East Java. Dedicated to building performant, accessible web applications and customizing high-throughput Minecraft Fabric servers with clean, maintainable code.

### Highlights

- Passionate about clean TypeScript architecture and responsive web UI
- Experienced in Fabric modding, JVM tuning, and multiplayer server setups
- Shipped 15+ web projects focused on performance and accessibility
